title: CSV to Markdown Table
h1: CSV to Markdown Table — GitHub-Flavored Tables
seoTitle: CSV to Markdown Table Converter — Free and Private
description: Turn CSV rows into a GitHub-flavored Markdown table, with an optional header row and comma, tab, or semicolon delimiters. Conversion stays in your browser.
intro: Paste CSV or tab-separated rows and get a Markdown table you can drop into a README, issue, or document. Quotes and separators are handled locally.
blurb: Convert CSV or TSV into a GitHub-flavored Markdown table in the browser.
howItWorks: Paste CSV, choose comma, tab, or semicolon, and say whether the first row is a header.
Press Convert to Markdown. Quoted fields can contain the delimiter.
Copy the table into GitHub, GitLab, or any Markdown file that supports pipe tables.
examples: A header plus two data rows becomes a three-line Markdown table with an alignment row.
Spreadsheet exports that use semicolons can be converted by switching the delimiter.
Pipe characters inside a cell are escaped so they do not break the table.

faq.a: It emits GitHub-flavored pipe tables: a header row, a separator row, then one row per record. Left alignment is used.

faq.q: Are quoted commas kept inside a cell?
faq.a: Yes. A standard CSV quote wraps a field, and a doubled quote inside that field becomes a literal quote.
No. Parsing and formatting run in your browser, so the pasted rows are not sent to ToolNova.
